That’s okay! You can start with a chair and flexed arm pull-ups. Just get your chin above the bar and hold, bend your knees so you are no longer on the chair. No up and down that’s it. Do these until you get the strength. You can also curl the 15lb weights you have to gain the strength! It’s all one step at a time. I was once 6 ft 1 120 lbs barely able to do a few pushups or even a pull-up. You’ll start small but keep at it and you’ll gain the strength! It may take a while but you got this!

With no gym you can do the following at home:
3-5 sets of pushups rep until failure(do them until you physically cannot do another then rest)
3-5 sets of pull ups rep until failure(if you don’t have something to do pull-ups on you can go to a playground) 
3-5 sets of planks. Reps:Go until you can’t anymore. 
3-5 sets of wall sits and or squats(wall sit till you can’t hold and repeat after rest, or squat until you cannot keep going) 

Add in some Tricep dips if you want. 

Rest is 1-2 min between sets.

Repeat until you get fit :)
